name: motionpath-gallery-fold
description: 曲线路径图像折叠展开画廊
interaction: Images are arranged along a curved motion path, folded like an accordion. As the user scrolls or drags, the gallery progressively unfolds along the path, revealing each image with a smooth rotation and scale transition. Folding back reverses the animation, creating a satisfying organic reveal-and-conceal rhythm.
